name: Antium Legs
description: If you're in need of top-of-the-line protection enhanced with bleeding-edge technology, look no further than the Antium Armor Set. Developed by the award-winning engineering team at Quirinus Tech, the suit is fully enclosed to protect its wearer against hazardous environments and the dangers of the battlefield. Instead of a traditional laminate faceplate, the helmet utilizes a suite of sensors to create an uncompromised field of vision.
